card.name: Inside drug company names
card.fires_on: Partway through pharmaceutical company names such as Schering, Teva, Novartis, AbbVie and Genzyme, or the Co in Merck & Co. It is strongest where the text says to contact or report to the company.

modes.label: Company name parts
modes.description: A middle or final piece of a drug manufacturer's name, often before Inc. or Corporation.

modes.label: Contact the company
modes.description: Company name inside an instruction to contact or report side effects to the manufacturer.
modes.example: You may report side effects to AbbV<<ie>>, Inc. at 1-8
